gancho: The dead come in, and no one goes out. Meet Hades, the unseen king of the Greek underworld, his ferryman, his three-headed dog, and the singer who almost beat him.
Sources: Homer (Iliad 15, Odyssey 11 and 24), Hesiod (Theogony), Virgil (Aeneid 6, Georgics 4) and Ovid (Metamorphoses 10).
capitulos: A king who never says yes
